_readme: Corrections for the Justice Week organisations widget.
Key = the organisation's name exactly as it appears in orgs-embed.html.
Per entry you may set: u = website URL, n = display name, i = initials shown when there is no logo, d = 1 to put a light logo on a navy tile (0 to undo).
Entries starting with an underscore are ignored. Delete an entry to drop the correction.
After editing, commit, then open once: https://purge.jsdelivr.net/gh/thehaguehumanityhub/thjw@main/overrides.json
